{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Licking County Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://myenergycoop.com/licking-county-pipeline-project|title=myenergycoop.com|website=myenergycoop.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thereportingproject.org/gas-line-easement-in-granville-township-will-benefit-the-open-space-program/|title=thereportingproject.org|website=thereportingproject.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from New Albany, Licking County, Ohio to near Hebron, Licking County, Ohio.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thereportingproject.org/energy-cooperative-proposes-24-mile-long-pipeline-across-licking-county/|title=thereportingproject.org|website=thereportingproject.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thereportingproject.org/gas-line-easement-in-granville-township-will-benefit-the-open-space-program/|title=thereportingproject.org|website=thereportingproject.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
